verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a built-in AI layer, Ramp Intelligence and Ramp agents, that takes over finance tasks inside the product: coding expenses, flagging fraud, approving within-policy spend, drafting memos, and parsing contracts to auto-fill request forms. The evidence describes these as autonomous, policy-driven automations. It does not show an in-product assistant the user can hand arbitrary tasks to on demand, and Ramp MCP connects external assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude, so it is not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant that accepts ad-hoc user-assigned tasks, detail on how users direct or scope delegated work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
